source_title: Filmmaker Hardik Gajjar announces two new ventures 'Tana Riri' and 'Ajay Abhimanyu Ki Mahabharat'
source_excerpt: Filmmaker Hardik Gajjar is all set to explore another fascinating chapter of Indian history after the success of Krishnavataram. He is reuniting with Krishnavataram actress Sanskruti Jayana for Tana Riri, a film based on a fascinating story from Indian history and folklore.About 'Tana and Riri'Set in 16th-century Gujarat, the film tells the story of twin sisters 'Tana and Riri' from Vadnagar. Known for their exceptional musical talent, the sisters are remembered for their devotion to classical music and their efforts to protect the honour of their land. The first poster of Tana Riri shows the twin sisters walking through the grand gates of a kingdom, offering a glimpse of the filmâs 16th-century setting and visual scale.'Ajay Abhimanyu Ki Mahabharat' in rowApart from Tana Riri, Hardik Gajjar is also working on another ambitious project based on the Mahabharata. Titled 'Ajay Abhimanyu Ki Mahabharat', the film will bring the legendary story of Abhimanyu to the big screen. Known for his courage, determination and sacrifice, Abhimanyu remains one of the most memorable characters from the epic.With these two films, the filmmaker aims to bring stories from India's history and mythology to the big screen for modern audiences.Release updatesBoth films are produced by Athashrikatha Motion Pictures LLP and directed by Hardik Gajjar.
